reviews.text: Last month we decided to finally tackle the basement renovation we'd been putting off for years. After getting quotes from several companies, we went with this crew based on their solid references and transparent pricing. From the first meeting they listened carefully to what we wanted and offered practical suggestions that actually saved us money without cutting corners. The framing, drywall, and flooring all came out beautifully. They handled a tricky electrical situation with the panel and coordinated the inspections smoothly. The whole process took about three weeks and we now have a gorgeous finished space that added real value to our home. I'd absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable contractors.

Craig and his team are the best contractors we (my family and I) have ever worked with. My mom hired CNG to remodel a cottage she bought from top to bottom. They reframed the floor, reinforced the ceiling, did two full bathroom remodels, a kitchen remodel … the list goes on. Craig even custom built a set of stairs to meet code in a very challenging area. He literally came up with his own design. I will attach some before and after photos. I highly recommend them. They came and worked hard every day. They’re professional, quick and serious about what they do. (Note image of stairs are not finished- railings still need to go up but they’re beautiful!)

We couldn't be happier with our complete master bathroom remodel recently completed by CNG Construction in Sept 2021.  Craig, the owner and his employee Mike were true professionals in all aspects of the job and the finished bathroom reflects their talent, attention to detail and dedication to delivering a high-quality master bath that we will enjoy for years to come.  They were also ON-TIME in all aspects of the project from from scheduling an appointment to provide an estimate, to starting the job the exact day promised at contract signing to completing the job in the time frame they committed to which minimized the disruption to our home that any remodel job brings.  While our job was in-process, it was their only focus from job start to completion.  CNG Construction is now our "go to" contractor and comes highly recommended !!
